bathAction.title: Wash face
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the face, then rinse the mouth and spit into the drain.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(cup)] warm water over [npc.her] face and [npc.verb(wipe)] carefully around [npc.her] [npc.eyes], then down the sides of [npc.her] nose and over [npc.her] [npc.lips]. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] [npc.her] mouth, [npc.verb(swill)] it, and [npc.verb(spit)] into the drain until the taste of the day is gone. [npc.speech(Eyes first. Then the mouth. I can still taste it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(press)] [npc.her] whole face into the hot water and [npc.verb(come)] up dripping, smiling, steam on [npc.her] [npc.lips]. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] [npc.her] mouth and [npc.verb(spit)] clean, then [npc.verb(do)] it again just for the heat. [npc.speech(Hot water on my face. Yes. Again.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] face with the heel of [npc.her] hand, hard across the cheeks and around [npc.her] mouth, then [npc.verb(rinse)] and [npc.verb(spit)] without lingering. Water runs off [npc.her] chin. [npc.speech(Spit, and we are moving on. I am not prettying it up.)]
